name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an order that has not yet shipped and release its reserved stock. Only pending and processing orders can be cancelled; once an order is shipped or delivered it must go through a return instead. Cancelling does not move money: call process_refund afterwards to return the customer's payment.

reason.description: Why the order is being cancelled. Recorded on the order.

error_returns.when: No order exists with the given order_id.
reason is not one of the listed values.
The order is already cancelled, or has shipped or been delivered.
